The printed title identifies संक्षिप्त गरुडपुराण, an abridged Hindi Gita Press edition, book code 1189, ISBN 81-293-0285-3. Translator/editor not identified; the filename is not evidence of an unabridged original. All 638 original PDF pages, artwork and watermarks are preserved byte-for-byte. 620 pages transcribed using PyMuPDF/Tesseract Hindi tessdata_best 4.1.0 at 300 dpi, using embedded scan images as derived OCR input. Curved column dividers, intervening full-width headings and footnotes determine reading order. Visually located inline illustrations on 24 pages are masked in derived OCR inputs; the opening illustration on page 456 is also excluded. 16 covers/publisher/illustration pages manually transcribed from rendered pages; two blank printed pages visually classified separately. Six navigation sections group front matter, contents, the three printed kandas and back covers; individual printed chapters are not separately indexed. Reading blocks retain OCR line breaks and source-page references; they are not canonical verse numbers. All nonempty OCR lines are retained, including running headers and possible ornament-recognition artifacts. OCR spelling, word spacing, Sanskrit recognition and layout still need editorial review. Coverage and sample checks do not establish accurate transcription of every printed word. Explicit unreviewed draft; the original scan edition is preserved. Reuse license remains unverified.
